description: Sacred Garden (Lumbini) is a notable religious destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. UNESCO World Heritage birthplace of Lord Buddha, showcasing the Maya Devi Temple, Ashokan Pillar, revered Pond, and a vast international monastic zone drawing pilgrims from across the globe. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

description: Maya Devi Temple is a notable religious destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Most revered monument in Lumbini, built directly over the age-old marker stone indicating the exact birthplace of Lord Buddha, surrounded by archaeological excavations revealing Mauryan and pre-Mauryan remains. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

description: Ashoka Pillar is a notable religious destination in Rupandehi district, part of Nepal's Lumbini Province. Erected by Emperor Ashoka during his pilgrimage to Lumbini in 249 BC, this carved sandstone pillar bears an inscription confirming the exact birthplace of the Buddha, making it one of the oldest dated records in South Asian history. It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

It is best visited during Oct-Apr and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.

It is best visited during Sep-May and offers an easy experience well suited to families and casual travelers.
